task_description: Complete Phase 2 stdlib: implement all remaining packages (auth, http client, mail, jobs, storage, websocket, ratelimit, compress, i18n, webhook, markdown, sanitize, csp, slug, cors, cli) and flash integration with view rendering

verification.summary: All 33 stdlib packages compile cleanly. All new integration tests pass when run individually. There is a pre-existing flaky SIGABRT issue in the VM that causes random test failures in any test (including pre-existing ones) when run in rapid succession, but all tests produce correct output and pass deterministically when run individually.
